rationale: One distinct OHLC-only price-action mean-reversion mechanism selected after source-native ADX/SMA terminal. No external-author performance claim and no result-driven parameter search.

data_contract.source_window: 2026-09-15..2026-10-04 existing consumed DEV; density-only preflight, no economic reuse claim
data_contract.bar_build: UTC-aligned complete 1h bars aggregated from verified 1m OHLCV; incomplete terminal bar excluded

causal_rule.entry_signal: Bars t-2,t-1,t are each bearish (close<open) and strictly descending by close (close[t-2]>close[t-1]>close[t]).
causal_rule.entry_fill: Enter long at next available complete bar t+1 open only if that open is strictly above the frozen stop; otherwise record gap-invalid missed signal and do not trade.
causal_rule.stop: Frozen at min(low[t-2],low[t-1],low[t]). For each held bar, adverse opening gap exits at that bar open; otherwise low<=stop exits at stop. Stop has priority over timeout.
causal_rule.exit: If not stopped, exit at the open exactly 24 hours after entry (bar t+25 open). No take-profit, trailing stop, indicator filter, symbol filter, month filter, or parameter sweep.
causal_rule.occupancy: At most one position per symbol; signals while occupied or on the same close that releases a position are recorded missed and never queued.
causal_rule.unresolved_terminal_gap: If the required timeout open is absent at dataset end, mark censored and exclude from closed-T while reporting it.

cost_contract.funding_bound: 24h maximum hold may cross up to three 8h settlements. Add two extra 1bp reserves to the frozen one-settlement reference cost for cost1x; cost2x doubles the resulting full per-symbol round-trip cost. This is a conservative historical-reference scenario, not actual historical funding reconstruction.

preflight_gates.duplicate_mechanism: Must not share exact causal entry/exit/time/occupancy fingerprint with a consumed identity; broad mean-reversion label alone is insufficient.
preflight_gates.syntax_clock: past-only completed bars; next-open entry; no current-bar close fill
preflight_gates.minimum_density: At least 20 closed trades on designated DEV before economic cheap
preflight_gates.global_heavy: Do not launch while any other economic heavy is active or pending; one owner claim only
preflight_gates.economic_terminal: Gross<=0 economic reject; Gross>0 and Net1<=0 cost reject; no same identity retune
preflight_gates.promotion: Development positive is HOLD; formal Survivor remains 0 until genuine W1/W2/W3/H4/H5/future evidence

negative_control.rule_delta: Replace the three bearish descending bars with three bullish ascending-close bars; identical fill/stop/timeout/occupancy.
negative_control.role: Direction-specific diagnostic only; not a second selectable strategy and not authorized for a separate heavy launch in this stage.

next_stage: Run read-only syntax/clock/duplicate/density preflight only. If eligible, wait for a clear shared heavy slot and create exactly one permanent claim before cost1x/2x cheap.
